items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 34:1
items.html: “Understand with Hochma” [הבן בחכמה] is the secret of the Bina that is concealed within the Hochma, which applies in upper AVI, where Bina is more important than Hochma, as above in answer 15. Therefore the Yod of HaVaYaH is the aspect of upper Abba, and the Vav and Dalet of the filling of the Yod are the secret of upper Ima, who is clothed and concealed within the Hochma, which is upper Abba. (Page 883, Item 34).
